title: Does Jiu Jitsu Get You Abs?
hook: Does jiu jitsu get you abs? Here's the honest answer from a black belt.
body: I'm a Brazilian Jiu Jitsu black belt who's been training for 22 years. Jiu jitsu does give you a great ab workout, both with the conditioning exercises we do and with wrestling live rounds. But it might be the hardest possible way to get abs. If you just want abs and you don't care about wrestling, gym ab exercises do the job faster. And nutrition is 80% of getting abs either way. You can't out-train a bad diet, not even with jiu jitsu.

youtube_description:
Does jiu jitsu get you abs? I'm a Brazilian Jiu Jitsu black belt who's been training for 22 years, and I've had a lot of people asking me this. Jiu jitsu does give you a great ab workout, both with the conditioning exercises and with live rounds. But it might be the hardest possible way to get abs. If you just want abs, gym ab exercises do the job faster. And remember, nutrition is 80% of getting abs whether you do jiu jitsu or not. So focus on how you're eating, not how you're training. If you love jiu jitsu, the ab workout is a great bonus.
